newsitem.title: USA: Novoste sells device to Merit.
newsitem.headline: Novoste sells device to Merit.

text.p: Novoste Corp said Thursday it sold its blood containment device and related assets to Merit Medical Systems Inc for an undisclosed price.
The company said the assets include the patents, know-how and equipment. It added Merit intends to market the device under the trade name Captiva blood containment device.
Novoste reported a net loss of $2.6 million, or $0.32 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a $1.2 million loss, or $0.24 a share, the year before. Its stock closed at 16-3/8 Wednesday.
